purpose: Evaluate limited NeuralRx overlap against the measured paired-radio S0 throughput
hardware: one A100-SXM4-40GB, MIG disabled, one MPS server, same physical GPU
ran_workload: two sequential valid 273-PRB PUSCH decodes per 20 ms release
ai_workload: Aerial NeuralRx TensorRT FP16 CUDA Graph, continuous overlap
selection_rule: Among caps with zero observed deadline misses and zero incorrect TBs, select the highest mean NeuralRx throughput; require throughput above the independent S0 reference.
